prompt: Produce the TicketRush M7 dashboard design reference using the frontend-design skill and the attached Dashboard design system. Deliver a self-contained index.html (inline CSS/JS, no npm dependencies, no external image/font requirements) and a PNG screenshot of the rendered desktop page in the project. This is a design-only artifact for owner approval BEFORE Angular implementation, not the real application. Clearly label all values as illustrative sample data and all interactions as demo only, never suggest they are live measurements. Language English only; never use en dash or em dash characters. Design one responsive, compact, accessible operational page, dark theme, IBM Plex Sans when available with safe fallback, blue CTA and meaningful status colors. No sidebar, routing, auth, marketing hero, charts or extra product features. Four zones: (1) stock for event concert-1 with unit price EUR 50.00 explicitly labeled seeded demo price (price is not returned by the stock read API); (2) orders per second with one decimal, computed from ordersInWindow / windowSeconds, 10-second window, polling every 2 seconds; (3) buy form with labeled event id default concert-1, quantity 1..4 default 1, Buy button, pending disabled state, Retry state explaining same idempotency key reused after network/5xx/429 failure; (4) recent-orders saga table showing order id, event id, quantity, status, amount + currency, failure reason, created and updated timestamps. Include illustrative PENDING, CONFIRMED, PAYMENT_FAILED and REJECTED rows, with failure reasons where applicable. Never expose customerId or idempotencyKey. Show clear stale/last-updated marker and sample loading/empty/error states through a small accessible demo-state control if useful. Demo interactions must not call real APIs, charge or reserve tickets. Preserve typed event and quantity when retrying. Keep the design simple enough to port to a minimal Angular page. Make the table usable on narrow screens with horizontal overflow and ensure no clipping on desktop. Please render and inspect the page; export a real PNG capture named dashboard.png, not a hand-drawn image. Return entry filename and screenshot filename. Do not modify any TicketRush repository files; generate only inside this Open Design project.
